authorship: Independently written from the mathematical specification; expected propositions were not obtained from inferred or printed Lean types.

targets.expected_type: ∀ (C : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (asymmetricLift C L) ↔ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ C
targets.scope: Global convexity is equivalent to convexity of the univariate profile, for the specified affine lift.

targets.expected_type: ∀ (C : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), Monotone (asymmetricLift C L) ↔ ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ C b - C a ∧ C b - C a ≤ L * (b - a)
targets.scope: Coordinatewise monotonicity is equivalent to all increasing secant increments lying between zero and width L times the increment; no differentiability requirement.

targets.expected_type: ∀ (C D : ℝ → ℝ) (hC : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt C (D x) x) (L : ℝ), Monotone (asymmetricLift C L) ↔ ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ D x ∧ D x ≤ L
targets.scope: For an everywhere differentiable profile, the exact criterion for the specified affine lift is that its derivative lies in [0,L] everywhere.

targets.expected_type: ∀ (P Q f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hP : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ P) (hQ : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Q) (hPd : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ P b - P a ∧ P b - P a ≤ L * (b - a)) (hQd : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ Q b - Q a ∧ Q b - Q a ≤ L * (b - a)) (hdiff : ∀ t : ℝ, P t - Q t = f t), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (asymmetricLift P L) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (asymmetricLift Q L) ∧ Monotone (asymmetricLift P L) ∧ Monotone (asymmetricLift Q L) ∧ ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, asymmetricLift P L z - asymmetricLift Q L z = f (z.1 - z.2)
targets.scope: The genuine abstract profile hypotheses yield two globally convex and coordinatewise monotone streams with exact reconstruction on all of R².

targets.expected_type: ∀ (C : ℝ → ℝ) (L x y c : ℝ), asymmetricLift C L (x + c, y + c) = asymmetricLift C L (x, y) + L * c
targets.scope: A common signed shift of the input streams adds exactly L times that shift to each lifted stream.

targets.expected_type: ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, asymmetricLift relu 1 z = max z.1 z.2 ∧ asymmetricLift (fun _ : ℝ => 0) 1 z = z.2
targets.scope: Exact global specialization to max and the second-coordinate identity, including signed input streams.

targets.expected_type: ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (asymmetricLift relu 1) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (asymmetricLift (fun _ : ℝ => 0) 1) ∧ Monotone (asymmetricLift relu 1) ∧ Monotone (asymmetricLift (fun _ : ℝ => 0) 1) ∧ ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, asymmetricLift relu 1 z - asymmetricLift (fun _ : ℝ => 0) 1 z = relu (z.1 - z.2)
targets.scope: ReLU itself satisfies the full generic split conclusion despite its nonsmooth point at zero.
